name: BAW 203 老人去世 复飞

cards.audioText:
B: Your call sign is Speedbird 203, you are just over Zulu Foxtrot.
C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Approach, climb to maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 203，刚过ZF。管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉进近，爬升保持4800米，联系武汉管制118.1。

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control, ask for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉管制，申请8900米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, maintaining 4800 meters, request climb to 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，保持4800米，申请爬升至8900米。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 7500 meters, expect 8900 meters at 16.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉管制，雷达联系，爬升至7500米，预计16分给8900米。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have encountered severe clear air turbulence ,and ask for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员你遇到严重晴空颠簸，并申请8900米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence, request 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，我们遇到严重晴空颠簸，申请8900米。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, Speedbird 203, climb to 8900 meters.

C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft or are there any passengers injured ?
B: Tell the controller that there isn't any aircraft damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉管制，飞机是否受损，是否有旅客受伤？
告诉管制员飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客都没事。
cards.referenceText: There isn't any damage to the aircraft and the purser reported that the passengers are just fine, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客情况都正常，BAW203。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just been told an old passenger has been seriously injured.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知武汉管制，你刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW203, we have just told that an old passenger has been seriously injured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW203，我们刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, roger, report your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，收到，报告意图。告诉管制员你希望在武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: We would like to land at Wuhan Airport, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们希望在武汉机场落地，BAW203。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, turn left direct to Zulu Foxtrot and descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，左转直飞ZF，下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF, descend to 5100 meters, BAW203.

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, do you need any assistance?
B: Inform the controller that you need an ambulance and first aid on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：Speedbird 203，是否需要任何协助？
告知管制员到达后需要救护车和急救。
cards.referenceText: We will need an ambulance and first aid on arrival, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 到达后我们需要救护车和急救，BAW203。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, maintain 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，保持5100米，联系武汉进近118.9。

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach, inform the controller that you have an injured passenger on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉进近，告知管制员机上有受伤旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW203, maintaining 5100 meters, over ZF, we have an injured passenger on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW203，保持5100米，过ZF，机上有一名受伤旅客。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow Zulu Foxtrot 1 Alpha arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information Charlie.
B: Readback the controller's instruction and inform controller that you have received the Information.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行ZF 1A进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，通播Charlie。请复诵管制指令，并告知管制员已收到通播。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF 1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, we have received Information C, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF 1A进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，已收到通播C，BAW203。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 203, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36 right.
B: Readback the controller's instruction and tell the controller that the passenger has died.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵管制指令，并告诉管制员该旅客已经死亡。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach runway 36R, the old passenger has died, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至900米，预计ILS进近36R，那名老年旅客已经死亡，BAW203。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, roger, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，收到，减速至200节，左转航向030。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030, BAW203.

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 203, intercept the localizer of runway 36 right, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 203，截获36右跑道航向道，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established, BAW203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 截获36R航向道，建立后报告，BAW203。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller, you have captured the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知管制员，你已截获航向道。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36 right, 13 kilometers from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，可以ILS进近36右跑道，距接地点13公里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during the approach, inform Tower controller that you need to make another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍后，进近至决断高度时你看不到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要再次进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW203, no contact at minimum, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW203，最低标准无目视，正在复飞。
